description: The plot illustrates the performance of five different methods across varying ratios, measured by the metric $\text{minADE}_{20} (\downarrow)$. The x-axis is labeled "Ratio" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled "$\text{minADE}_{20} (\downarrow)$" and uses a linear scale with a visible data range from approximately 0.52 to 0.785, featuring numeric tick labels at intervals of 0.05 from 0.60 to 0.75. The "TrajICL" method is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers; it maintains a relatively steady trend, starting at approximately 0.605 at a ratio of 0.1, dipping slightly to 0.595 at 0.3, and ending at 0.59 at a ratio of 1.0. The "Head Tuning" method is shown as a solid orange line with circular markers, exhibiting a steady decline from a high of approximately 0.785 at a ratio of 0.1 down to 0.685 at a ratio of 1.0. The "FT" method, depicted by a solid green line with circular markers, also shows a declining trend, starting at 0.685 at a ratio of 0.1, dropping to 0.63 at 0.2, and continuing to decrease to approximately 0.52 at a ratio of 1.0. The "LoRA 16" method is indicated by a solid red line with circular markers, decreasing from approximately 0.74 at a ratio of 0.1 to 0.61 at 0.7, and ending at 0.605 at a ratio of 1.0. Finally, the "LoRA 64" method, represented by a solid purple line with circular markers, closely follows the LoRA 16 trend, starting at 0.745 at a ratio of 0.1, declining to 0.615 at 0.7, and ending at 0.605 at a ratio of 1.0.
